exposure: mothers who had assisted vaginal deliveries
number of individuals providing significant help
cohort: 373 mothers attending a public primary care clinic in Singapore with their infants aged 4-8 weeks
finding: Pain on passing urine was more frequent after assisted vaginal deliveries than all other forms of deliveries, and pain on passing motion was more frequent in vaginal deliveries than in Caesarean deliveries.
